body: Character reference sheet illustration, painted digital cel-shaded art style with bold clean linework (like a professional character-design turnaround, not a photo). A young Black woman with curly dark hair pulled back under a lime-green headband, gold hoop earrings, amber eyes, standing in a strict scarecrow T-POSE facing the camera dead-on: BOTH ARMS LOCKED COMPLETELY STRAIGHT OUT HORIZONTALLY TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height, elbows perfectly straight, both open empty hands with fingers spread, a large visible gap of empty background between each hand and the torso, nothing held (no weapon, no gear, hands completely empty), legs straight shoulder-width apart. REAL ADULT HUMAN PROPORTIONS (7-8 heads tall, NOT chibi, NOT stylized-short) -- an athletic normal build. A lime-green puffer jacket worn open over a hot-pink cropped top, black leggings with an orange side-stripe, lime-green and orange high-top cyberpunk sneakers with visible tech detailing, a black fingerless glove on one hand. Bold cel-shaded flat colors within the lime-green/black/hot-pink/orange palette, thick clean outlines. Plain flat light-grey studio background so the silhouette reads clearly, full body visible head to feet, no text, no logos, no watermark
